title: Plain washers, small series, product grade A
notes: The true narrow/small series (= DIN 433), the low-profile washer that fits under a socket head cap screw where a normal-series washer would foul the head recess. Not to be confused with ISO 7089 (normal) or ISO 7093 (large) / ISO 7094 (extra-large).
